title: nan
authors: Lu H.; Shen H.; Tian B.; Zhang X.; Yang Z.; Zong Q.
key_contribution: Presents a complete autonomous navigation system (perception, motion planning, and control) for micro-aerial vehicles in GPS-denied environments, validated by experimental testing.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Hybrid_Classical_Learning to ensure precise positioning.
